subject.title: [Feature]: Thread replies when agent uses tools; top-level for conversational responses

question: Should Slack add a default-off tool-use-sensitive reply policy, and what precedence should it have relative to the existing replyToMode controls and streaming/status behavior?
rationale: Source inspection proves the feature is absent, but the proposed fix adds a compatibility-sensitive config surface and changes when Slack starts visible threads.

options.title: Approve Precise Slack Policy
options.body: Define the config shape and precedence, then implement the Slack-owned schema, routing, docs, and focused tests with default false.

options.title: Use Static Reply Controls Only
options.body: Treat account, chat-type, and per-channel replyToMode as the supported solution for channel cleanliness and close or deprioritize this feature direction.

options.title: Defer To Cross-Channel Policy
options.body: Hold this issue until maintainers design a broader reply-placement policy instead of adding Slack-specific config now.

recommendation.title: Approve Precise Slack Policy
recommendation.body: Define the config shape and precedence, then implement the Slack-owned schema, routing, docs, and focused tests with default false.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on Slack reply-mode config and adjacent Slack threading behavior.
